capabilities: create missing daily notes from created frontmatter dates
watch Markdown file changes and sync daily notes automatically
run a full vault scan via command palette
process the current file from the file explorer context menu
read the Daily Notes core plugin folder and template configuration
extras: The plugin's UI, notices, and settings use Chinese; a Chinese README is available. The README includes developer-oriented review notes (TypeScript source, tests, esbuild build, no Node-only modules).
intentEvidence: Reuses Obsidian's built-in Daily Notes configuration first, then falls back to plugin settings.
problem: Obsidian creates daily notes on the day you open them, so notes created earlier have no corresponding daily notes for their original dates.
summary: Daily note backfiller that automatically creates missing daily notes from the created field in each note's frontmatter.
